children: Option traders are expecting a 6% swing in the shares of Take-Two Interactive Software
following the highly anticipated launch of
Grand Theft Auto 6
at midnight on Thursday.
Shares of the owner of Rockstar Games, which develops the game, were soaring on Wednesday, with shares up 7.31% to $218.84 during mid-day trading.

The at-the-money straddle for Friday's expiration implies traders are pricing in a post-earnings move of about 6.14% in either direction. Based on the current share price of $218.84, the options market suggests an expected trading range of roughly $205.41- $232.27.

Traders are displaying mixed positioning in the November 20 weekly options. The $205 put has the highest open interest among near-term put strikes, at 8,372 contracts, while the $290 call leads on the call side, with open interest of 12,938 contracts.
The launch, which comes 13 years after the release of its predecessor,
Grand Theft Auto 5
, is

params.linkText: expected to have a far-reaching impact

children: that could boost stocks ranging from Sony
, Microsoft
, and AMD
to GameStop
, Best Buy
, Logitech
, and Corsair

Overall, options sentiment leans towards upside, with 74,739 call contracts and 45,175 put contracts. This puts the put/call open interest ratio at 0.60, below the 1.0 level typically associated with a balanced positioning between calls and puts.

Across the broader options chain, open interest is concentrated at strikes well away from current levels. The $300 call has the highest open interest among call options, at 21,901 contracts, while the $180 put leads among put options, with 21,091 contracts.
